name: Echani Ritual Brand
description: The Echani Ritual Brand was a type of double-bladed sword used in ritual combat by Echani Firedancers. The Echani used the blade in a graceful pattern of dodging and slicing, causing the combat to appear similar to a dance. The melee weapon consisted of two Cortosis-weave blades joined in the center by a colored hilt. It was capable of withstanding a lightsaber.
